task: Design and evaluate KA-GNN (Kolmogorov-Arnold Graph Neural Networks) for molecular property prediction
core_method: KA-GNN replaces MLP transformations in GNNs with Fourier-based KAN modules
key_components: FourierKANLayer: learnable univariate functions via Fourier series basis
KAGNNConv: message passing with KAN-based message and update functions
MultiFeatureEmbedding: separate embeddings for atom/bond categorical features
Non-covalent interaction edges: 3D conformer-based edges via MMFF optimization
evaluation: 80/10/10 train/val/test split, 50 epochs, early stopping patience=15
